global.title: Studies confirm performance of Artemis 2 heat shield
global.summary: WASHINGTON — Detailed engineering studies have confirmed that the Orion heat shield on the Artemis 2 mission performed as expected, without the erosion seen on Artemis 1.

global.title: European cellular giants seek satellite partner for sovereign D2D service
global.summary: TAMPA, Fla. — Four of Europe’s largest cellular operators said Oct. 19 they are seeking a satellite partner to deploy sovereign direct-to-device services, after signing a letter of intent to explore a joint bid for spectrum needed to provide D2D connectivity from space.
